posteriores.texto: Naquela noite, o anjo do SENHOR saiu e feriu, no acampamento da Assíria, cento e oitenta e cinco mil. Quando se levantaram cedo pela manhã, todos eram cadáveres, mortos.
Então Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria, partiu, foi e voltou; e permaneceu em Nínive.

kjv.texto: For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

vizinhos.33: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the Lord.
vizinhos.35: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the Lord went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
